1	"""Encode and decode fixed-length EBCDIC records (DISPLAY text, zoned, packed and binary)."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	from decimal import Decimal
6	from typing import Any, Dict, List
7	
8	from .copybook import Field, Layout
9	
10	CODEPAGE = "cp037"
11	EBCDIC_SPACE = b"\x40"
12	_POSITIVE = {0xA, 0xC, 0xE, 0xF}
13	_NEGATIVE = {0xB, 0xD}
14	
15	
16	class CodecError(ValueError):
17	    """Raised when a value cannot be encoded, or bytes cannot be decoded, for a field."""
18	
19	
20	def _quantum(field: Field) -> Decimal:
21	    return Decimal(1).scaleb(-field.scale)
22	
23	
24	def _digit_string(field: Field, value: Any) -> str:
25	    number = Decimal(value)
26	    if number < 0 and not field.signed:
27	        raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: negative value {number} for an unsigned field")
28	    scaled = abs(number) * (Decimal(10) ** field.scale)
29	    if scaled != scaled.to_integral_value():
30	        raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: {number} has more than {field.scale} decimal places")
31	    digits = str(int(scaled))
32	    if len(digits) > field.total_digits:
33	        raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: {number} does not fit {field.describe()}")
34	    return digits.zfill(field.total_digits)
35	
36	
37	def encode_item(field: Field, value: Any) -> bytes:
38	    """Encode one occurrence of a field."""
39	    if field.kind == "X":
40	        text = "" if value is None else str(value)
41	        if len(text) > field.item_length:
42	            raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: {text!r} is longer than {field.item_length}")
43	        try:
44	            return text.ljust(field.item_length).encode(CODEPAGE)
45	        except UnicodeEncodeError as exc:
46	            raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: {text!r} has characters outside {CODEPAGE}") from exc
47	
48	    if value is None:
49	        value = 0
50	    negative = Decimal(value) < 0
51	    digits = _digit_string(field, value)
52	    if field.kind == "9":
53	        out = bytearray(0xF0 | int(d) for d in digits)
54	        if field.signed:
55	            out[-1] = (0xD0 if negative else 0xC0) | int(digits[-1])
56	        return bytes(out)
57	    if field.kind == "B":
58	        number = -int(digits) if negative else int(digits)
59	        order = "little" if field.little_endian else "big"
60	        try:
61	            return number.to_bytes(field.item_length, order, signed=field.signed)
62	        except OverflowError as exc:
63	            raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: {value} does not fit {field.item_length} bytes") from exc
64	
65	    sign =0xD if negative else (0xC if field.signed else 0xF)
66	    nibbles = [int(d) for d in digits] + [sign]
67	    if len(nibbles) % 2:
68	        nibbles.insert(0, 0)
69	    return bytes((nibbles[i] << 4) | nibbles[i + 1] for i in range(0, len(nibbles), 2))
70	
71	
72	def decode_item(field: Field, data: bytes) -> Any:
73	    """Decode one occurrence of a field. Numeric values come back as Decimal."""
74	    if field.kind == "X":
75	        return data.decode(CODEPAGE)
76	
77	    negative = False
78	    if field.kind == "B":
79	        order = "little" if field.little_endian else "big"
80	        number = int.from_bytes(data, order, signed=field.signed)
81	        value = Decimal(number).scaleb(-field.scale).quantize(_quantum(field))
82	        return value if number else abs(value)
83	    if field.kind == "9":
84	        digits = []
85	        for index, byte in enumerate(data):
86	            zone, digit = byte >> 4, byte & 0xF
87	            if digit > 9:
88	                raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: invalid zoned digit 0x{byte:02X}")
89	            if index == len(data) - 1 and field.signed:
90	                if zone in _NEGATIVE:
91	                    negative = True
92	                elif zone not in _POSITIVE:
93	                    raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: invalid sign zone 0x{byte:02X}")
94	            elif zone != 0xF:
95	                raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: invalid zoned byte 0x{byte:02X}")
96	            digits.append(digit)
97	    else:
98	        nibbles: List[int] = []
99	        for byte in data:
100	            nibbles.extend((byte >> 4, byte & 0xF))
101	        sign = nibbles.pop()
102	        if any(n > 9 for n in nibbles):
103	            raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: invalid packed digit in {data.hex().upper()}")
104	        if sign in _NEGATIVE:
105	            negative = True
106	        elif sign not in _POSITIVE:
107	            raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: invalid packed sign nibble 0x{sign:X}")
108	        digits = nibbles
109	
110	    number = int("".join(str(d) for d in digits) or "0")
111	    value = Decimal(number).scaleb(-field.scale).quantize(_quantum(field))
112	    return -value if negative and number else value
113	
114	
115	def _items(field: Field, value: Any) -> List[Any]:
116	    if field.occurs == 1:
117	        return [value]
118	    values = list(value or [])
119	    if len(values) > field.occurs:
120	        raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: {len(values)} items for OCCURS {field.occurs}")
121	    return values + [None] * (field.occurs - len(values))
122	
123	
124	def encode_record(layout: Layout, record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
125	    """Encode a record dict into one fixed-length EBCDIC record."""
126	    unknown = set(record) - set(layout.names())
127	    if unknown:
128	        raise CodecError(f"Unknown fields: {sorted(unknown)}")
129	    buffer = bytearray(EBCDIC_SPACE * layout.record_length)
130	    for field in layout.fields:
131	        for index, item in enumerate(_items(field, record.get(field.name))):
132	            start = field.offset + index * field.item_length
133	            buffer[start : start + field.item_length] = encode_item(field, item)
134	    return bytes(buffer)
135	
136	
137	def decode_record(layout: Layout, data: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
138	    """Decode one fixed-length record into a dict of field name -> value (or list)."""
139	    if len(data) != layout.record_length:
140	        raise CodecError(f"Record is {len(data)} bytes, layout expects {layout.record_length}")
141	    record: Dict[str, Any] = {}
142	    for field in layout.fields:
143	        if field.offset < 0 or field.offset + field.length > len(data):
144	            raise CodecError(f"{field.name}: field extends outside the record")
145	        items = [
146	            decode_item(field, data[start : start + field.item_length])
147	            for start in range(field.offset, field.offset + field.length, field.item_length)
148	        ]
149	        record[field.name] = items if field.occurs > 1 else items[0]
150	    return record
151	
152	
153	def split_records(layout: Layout, data: bytes) -> List[bytes]:
154	    """Split a fixed-block (RECFM=F) file into records."""
155	    size = layout.record_length
156	    if len(data) % size:
157	        raise CodecError(f"File size {len(data)} is not a multiple of record length {size}")
158	    return [data[i : i + size] for i in range(0, len(data), size)]

1	"""Mapping specifications: how each source record becomes a target JSON document.
2	
3	A mapping is a YAML file::
4	
5	    name: claim-header
6	    key: R1                              # rule that identifies a document
7	    filter: {field: REC-TYPE, equals: D} # records that are loaded at all
8	    rules:
9	      - id: R1
10	        source: CLAIM-ID                 # copybook field
11	        target: claimId                  # dotted JSON path in the output document
12	        steps: [strip]                   # ordered transformations
13	        checks: [required, {pattern: '^C[0-9]+$'}]   # validations on the result
14	        on_error: reject                 # invalid input -> reject record (default: fail)
15	
16	      - id: R9
17	        source: [FIRST-NAME, LAST-NAME]  # concatenation
18	        separator: " "
19	        target: member.fullName
20	
21	      - id: R10
22	        value: MEDICAID                  # constant
23	        target: sourceSystem
24	
25	      - id: R11
26	        source: ADMIT-DATE
27	        when: {field: CLAIM-TYPE, equals: IP}   # conditional mapping
28	        else: null
29	        target: admission.date
30	        steps: [{date: {in: "%Y%m%d", out: "%Y-%m-%d", nulls: ["00000000"]}}]
31	
32	This module also holds the reference implementation of the mapping, which is
33	what WitnessForge treats as the specification of correct behaviour.
34	"""
35	
36	from __future__ import annotations
37	
38	import re
39	from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
40	from datetime import datetime
41	from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
42	from pathlib import Path
43	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
44	
45	import yaml
46	
47	from .copybook import Field, Layout
48	
49	PUBLIC_STEPS = {
50	    "strip", "rstrip", "lstrip", "upper", "lower", "number", "null_if_blank", "date", "map",
51	    "default", "substring", "lstrip_zeros", "pad", "boolean", "multiply", "divide", "round",
52	    "replace",
53	}
54	CHECKS = {
55	    "required", "min_length", "max_length", "min", "max", "pattern", "allowed",
56	    "min_items", "max_items", "unique_items", "unique",
57	}
58	ARRAY_CHECKS = {"min_items", "max_items", "unique_items"}
59	CONDITION_OPS = ("equals", "in", "not_blank", "blank")
60	REJECTED = "__rejected__"
61	FILTERED = "__filtered__"
62	
63	Step = Tuple[str, Any]
64	
65	
66	class MappingError(ValueError):
67	    """Raised for an invalid mapping specification or a failing transformation."""
68	
69	
70	@dataclass(frozen=True)
71	class Condition:
72	    field: str
73	    op: str
74	    values: Tuple[Any, ...] = ()
75	    negate: bool = False  # set only by mutants
76	
77	    def describe(self) -> str:
78	        text = {
79	            "equals": f"{self.field} = {self.values[0]!r}" if self.values else self.field,
80	            "in": f"{self.field} in {list(self.values)}",
81	            "not_blank": f"{self.field} is not blank",
82	            "blank": f"{self.field} is blank",
83	        }[self.op]
84	        return f"NOT ({text})" if self.negate else text
85	
86	
87	@dataclass(frozen=True)
88	class Rule:
89	    id: str
90	    target: str
91	    sources: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
92	    steps: Tuple[Step, ...] = ()
93	    checks: Tuple[Step, ...] = ()
94	    drop_blank: bool = False
95	    value: Any = None  # constant, used when there are no sources
96	    separator: str = ""
97	    trim_parts: bool = True
98	    when: Optional[Condition] = None
99	    when_else: Any = None
100	    on_error: str = "fail"  # fail | reject   ("null" is used only by mutants)
101	    distinct: bool = False  # remove duplicate array items
102	    items: Tuple[Tuple[str, "Rule"], ...] = ()  # array of objects from parallel OCCURS fields
103	    shift: int = 0  # set only by mutants: read element i+shift (misaligned OCCURS)
104	    array_op: Optional[str] = None  # set only by mutants
105	    parts_op: Optional[str] = None  # set only by mutants
106	
107	    @property
108	    def source(self) -> Optional[str]:
109	        return self.sources[0] if len(self.sources) == 1 else None
110	
111	    @property
112	    def is_constant(self) -> bool:
113	        return not self.sources and not self.items
114	
115	    @property
116	    def all_sources(self) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
117	        """Every copybook field this rule reads (including object-array members)."""
118	        if self.items:
119	            return tuple(sub.source for _, sub in self.items)
120	        return self.sources
121	
122	    def with_item(self, name: str, sub: "Rule") -> "Rule":
123	        return replace(self, items=tuple((n, sub if n == name else r) for n, r in self.items))
124	
125	    @property
126	    def is_concat(self) -> bool:
127	        return len(self.sources) > 1
128	
129	
130	@dataclass(frozen=True)
131	class Mapping:
132	    name: str
133	    rules: Tuple[Rule, ...]
134	    key: Optional[str] = None  # id of the rule whose output identifies a document
135	    filter: Optional[Condition] = None
136	
137	    @property
138	    def key_rule(self) -> Optional[Rule]:
139	        return self.rule(self.key) if self.key else None
140	
141	    def rule(self, rule_id: str) -> Rule:
142	        for rule in self.rules:
143	            if rule.id == rule_id:
144	                return rule
145	        raise KeyError(rule_id)
146	
147	    def with_rule(self, new_rule: Rule) -> "Mapping":
148	        return replace(
149	            self, rules=tuple(new_rule if r.id == new_rule.id else r for r in self.rules)
150	        )

156	def _one_key(rule_id: str, raw: Any, what: str) -> Tuple[str, Any]:
157	    if isinstance(raw, str):
158	        return raw, None
159	    if isinstance(raw, dict) and len(raw) == 1:
160	        return next(iter(raw.items()))
161	    raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: each {what} must be a name or a one-key mapping, got {raw!r}")
162	
163	
164	def _normalize_step(rule_id: str, raw: Any) -> Step:
165	    op, arg = _one_key(rule_id, raw, "step")
166	    if op not in PUBLIC_STEPS:
167	        raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: unknown step {op!r} (known: {sorted(PUBLIC_STEPS)})")
168	    if op == "date":
169	        if not (isinstance(arg, dict) and "in" in arg and "out" in arg):
170	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: date step needs 'in' and 'out' formats")
171	        arg = {"in": arg["in"], "out": arg["out"], "nulls": [str(n) for n in arg.get("nulls") or []]}
172	    elif op == "map":
173	        if not (isinstance(arg, dict) and isinstance(arg.get("values"), dict)):
174	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: map step needs a 'values' dictionary")
175	        arg = {"values": {str(k): v for k, v in arg["values"].items()}, "default": arg.get("default")}
176	    elif op == "substring":
177	        if not (isinstance(arg, dict) and int(arg.get("start", 0)) >= 1 and int(arg.get("length", 0)) >= 1):
178	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: substring needs start >= 1 and length >= 1")
179	        arg = {"start": int(arg["start"]), "length": int(arg["length"])}
180	    elif op == "pad":
181	        if not (isinstance(arg, dict) and int(arg.get("length", 0)) >= 1):
182	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: pad needs a length")
183	        side = arg.get("side", "left")
184	        char = str(arg.get("char", " "))
185	        if side not in ("left", "right") or len(char) != 1:
186	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: pad side must be left/right and char one character")
187	        arg = {"length": int(arg["length"]), "char": char, "side": side}
188	    elif op == "boolean":
189	        if isinstance(arg, dict):  # YAML reads the keys true/false as booleans
190	            arg = {str(k).lower(): v for k, v in arg.items()}
191	        if not (isinstance(arg, dict) and arg.get("true") and arg.get("false")):
192	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: boolean needs 'true' and 'false' value lists")
193	        arg = {
194	            "true": [str(v) for v in _as_list(arg["true"])],
195	            "false": [str(v) for v in _as_list(arg["false"])],
196	            "default": arg.get("default"),
197	        }
198	    elif op in ("multiply", "divide"):
199	        try:
200	            arg = Decimal(str(arg))
201	        except Exception as exc:
202	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: {op} needs a number") from exc
203	        if op == "divide" and arg == 0:
204	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: divide by zero")
205	    elif op == "round":
206	        if not isinstance(arg, int) or arg < 0:
207	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: round needs a number of decimal places")
208	    elif op == "replace":
209	        if not (isinstance(arg, dict) and "pattern" in arg):
210	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: replace needs 'pattern' (and 'with')")
211	        _compile(rule_id, arg["pattern"])
212	        arg = {"pattern": arg["pattern"], "with": str(arg.get("with", ""))}
213	    return op, arg
214	
215	
216	def _normalize_check(rule_id: str, raw: Any) -> Step:
217	    op, arg = _one_key(rule_id, raw, "check")
218	    if op not in CHECKS:
219	        raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: unknown check {op!r} (known: {sorted(CHECKS)})")
220	    if op in ("required", "unique_items", "unique"):
221	        return op, None
222	    if op in ("min_length", "max_length", "min_items", "max_items"):
223	        if not isinstance(arg, int) or arg < 0:
224	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: {op} needs a non-negative integer")
225	    elif op in ("min", "max"):
226	        try:
227	            arg = Decimal(str(arg))
228	        except Exception as exc:
229	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: {op} needs a number") from exc
230	    elif op == "pattern":
231	        _compile(rule_id, arg)
232	    elif op == "allowed":
233	        if not isinstance(arg, list) or not arg:
234	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: allowed needs a non-empty list")
235	        arg = tuple(arg)
236	    return op, arg
237	
238	
239	def _compile(rule_id: str, pattern: Any) -> None:
240	    try:
241	        re.compile(str(pattern))
242	    except re.error as exc:
243	        raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: invalid regular expression {pattern!r}: {exc}") from exc
244	
245	
246	def _as_list(value: Any) -> List[Any]:
247	    return list(value) if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) else [value]
248	
249	
250	def _condition(owner: str, raw: Any, layout: Optional[Layout]) -> Condition:
251	    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or "field" not in raw:
252	        raise MappingError(f"{owner}: a condition needs 'field' and one of {CONDITION_OPS}")
253	    ops = [op for op in CONDITION_OPS if op in raw]
254	    if len(ops) != 1:
255	        raise MappingError(f"{owner}: a condition needs exactly one of {CONDITION_OPS}")
256	    field_name = str(raw["field"]).upper()
257	    if layout is not None:
258	        if field_name not in layout.names():
259	            raise MappingError(f"{owner}: condition field {field_name} is not in the copybook")
260	        if layout.field(field_name).occurs > 1:
261	            raise MappingError(f"{owner}: condition field {field_name} cannot be an OCCURS field")
262	    op = ops[0]
263	    values: Tuple[Any, ...] = ()
264	    if op == "equals":
265	        values = (raw["equals"],)
266	    elif op == "in":
267	        values = tuple(_as_list(raw["in"]))
268	    return Condition(field=field_name, op=op, values=values)
269	
270	
271	def _parse_items(rule_id: str, target: str, raw: Any, layout: Optional[Layout]):
272	    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or not raw:
273	        raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: 'items' must map object keys to source fields")
274	    items = []
275	    occurs = set()
276	    for name, spec in raw.items():
277	        if isinstance(spec, str):
278	            spec = {"source": spec}
279	        if not isinstance(spec, dict) or not spec.get("source"):
280	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}.{name}: needs a 'source' field")
281	        source = str(spec["source"]).upper()
282	        sub_id = f"{rule_id}.{name}"
283	        if layout is not None:
284	            if source not in layout.names():
285	                raise MappingError(f"{sub_id}: source field {source} is not in the copybook")
286	            occurs.add(layout.field(source).occurs)
287	        sub = Rule(
288	            id=sub_id,
289	            target=f"{target}.{name}",
290	            sources=(source,),
291	            steps=tuple(_normalize_step(sub_id, s) for s in spec.get("steps") or []),
292	            checks=tuple(_normalize_check(sub_id, c) for c in spec.get("checks") or []),
293	        )
294	        if any(op in ARRAY_CHECKS or op == "unique" for op, _ in sub.checks):
295	            raise MappingError(f"{sub_id}: array and dataset checks belong on the parent rule")
296	        items.append((str(name), sub))
297	    if layout is not None and (len(occurs) != 1 or occurs.pop() < 2):
298	        raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: item sources must be OCCURS fields with the same count")
299	    return tuple(items)

302	def mapping_from_dict(data: Dict[str, Any], layout: Optional[Layout] = None) -> Mapping:
303	    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("rules"), list) or not data["rules"]:
304	        raise MappingError("Mapping must contain a non-empty 'rules' list")
305	    rules: List[Rule] = []
306	    ids, targets = set(), set()
307	    for index, raw in enumerate(data["rules"], start=1):
308	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
309	            raise MappingError(f"Rule #{index} must be a mapping")
310	        rule_id = str(raw.get("id") or f"R{index}")
311	        if rule_id in ids:
312	            raise MappingError(f"Duplicate rule id {rule_id}")
313	        if not raw.get("target"):
314	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: missing 'target'")
315	        target = str(raw["target"])
316	        if target in targets:
317	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: target {target} is mapped twice")
318	
319	        items: Tuple[Tuple[str, Rule], ...] = ()
320	        source = raw.get("source")
321	        if raw.get("items") is not None:
322	            items = _parse_items(rule_id, target, raw["items"], layout)
323	            sources = ()
324	        elif source is None:
325	            if "value" not in raw:
326	                raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: needs a 'source' field or a constant 'value'")
327	            sources: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
328	        else:
329	            sources = tuple(str(s).upper() for s in _as_list(source))
330	            if not sources:
331	                raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: 'source' is empty")
332	        if layout is not None:
333	            for name in sources:
334	                if name not in layout.names():
335	                    raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: source field {name} is not in the copybook")
336	            if len(sources) > 1 and any(layout.field(s).occurs > 1 for s in sources):
337	                raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: OCCURS fields cannot be concatenated")
338	
339	        steps = raw.get("steps") or []
340	        checks = raw.get("checks") or []
341	        if not isinstance(steps, list) or not isinstance(checks, list):
342	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: 'steps' and 'checks' must be lists")
343	        on_error = str(raw.get("on_error", "fail"))
344	        if on_error not in ("fail", "reject"):
345	            raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: on_error must be 'fail' or 'reject'")
346	
347	        checks_parsed = tuple(_normalize_check(rule_id, c) for c in checks)
348	        is_array = bool(items) or (
349	            layout is not None and len(sources) == 1 and layout.field(sources[0]).occurs > 1
350	        )
351	        if layout is not None and not is_array:
352	            bad = [op for op, _ in checks_parsed if op in ARRAY_CHECKS]
353	            if bad or raw.get("distinct"):
354	                raise MappingError(f"{rule_id}: {bad or 'distinct'} only applies to array rules")
355	
356	        ids.add(rule_id)
357	        targets.add(target)
358	        rules.append(
359	            Rule(
360	                id=rule_id,
361	                target=target,
362	                sources=sources,
363	                steps=tuple(_normalize_step(rule_id, s) for s in steps),
364	                checks=checks_parsed,
365	                drop_blank=bool(raw.get("drop_blank", False)),
366	                distinct=bool(raw.get("distinct", False)),
367	                items=items,
368	                value=raw.get("value"),
369	                separator=str(raw.get("separator", "")),
370	                trim_parts=bool(raw.get("trim", True)),
371	                when=_condition(rule_id, raw["when"], layout) if raw.get("when") else None,
372	                when_else=raw.get("else"),
373	                on_error=on_error,
374	            )
375	        )
376	
377	    key = data.get("key")
378	    if key is not None:
379	        key = str(key)
380	        if key not in ids:
381	            raise MappingError(f"key {key!r} is not a rule id")
382	        key_rule = next(r for r in rules if r.id == key)
383	        if key_rule.source is None:
384	            raise MappingError(f"key rule {key} must read exactly one source field")
385	        if layout is not None and layout.field(key_rule.source).occurs > 1:
386	            raise MappingError(f"key rule {key} cannot read an OCCURS field")
387	    record_filter = _condition("filter", data["filter"], layout) if data.get("filter") else None
388	    return Mapping(
389	        name=str(data.get("name") or "mapping"), rules=tuple(rules), key=key, filter=record_filter
390	    )

393	class _SpecLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
394	    """YAML loader where only true/false are booleans (YAML 1.2 style).
395	
396	    Plain YAML 1.1 turns codes such as NO (Norway), YES, ON and OFF into booleans,
397	    which silently corrupts lookup tables and allowed-value lists.
398	    """
399	
400	
401	_SpecLoader.yaml_implicit_resolvers = {
402	    first: [(tag, regexp) for tag, regexp in resolvers if tag != "tag:yaml.org,2002:bool"]
403	    for first, resolvers in yaml.SafeLoader.yaml_implicit_resolvers.items()
404	}
405	_SpecLoader.add_implicit_resolver(
406	    "tag:yaml.org,2002:bool", re.compile(r"^(?:true|True|TRUE|false|False|FALSE)$"), list("tTfF")
407	)

411	    data = yaml.load(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), Loader=_SpecLoader)  # noqa: S506
412	    return mapping_from_dict(data, layout)

418	class RuleRejected(Exception):
419	    """A rule with on_error: reject could not transform its input."""
420	
421	
422	def _is_blank(value: Any) -> bool:
423	    return value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip())
424	
425	
426	def _norm(value: Any) -> str:
427	    return value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) else ("" if value is None else str(value))
428	
429	
430	def _equal(a: Any, b: Any) -> bool:
431	    try:
432	        return Decimal(_norm(a)) == Decimal(_norm(b))
433	    except Exception:
434	        return _norm(a) == _norm(b)
435	
436	
437	def condition_matches(record: Dict[str, Any], condition: Condition) -> bool:
438	    value = record[condition.field]
439	    if condition.op == "equals":
440	        result = _equal(value, condition.values[0])
441	    elif condition.op == "in":
442	        result = any(_equal(value, v) for v in condition.values)
443	    elif condition.op == "not_blank":
444	        result = not _is_blank(value)
445	    else:
446	        result = _is_blank(value)
447	    return not result if condition.negate else result
448	
449	
450	def _arith(value: Any, fn) -> Any:
451	    if _is_blank(value):
452	        return None
453	    was_float = isinstance(value, float)
454	    was_int = isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
455	    result = fn(Decimal(str(value).strip()))
456	    if was_float:
457	        return float(result)
458	    if was_int:
459	        return int(result) if result == result.to_integral_value() else float(result)
460	    return result
461	
462	
463	def apply_step(value: Any, op: str, arg: Any, field: Optional[Field]) -> Any:
464	    if op in ("strip", "rstrip", "lstrip", "upper", "lower"):
465	        return getattr(value, op)() if isinstance(value, str) else value
466	    if op == "null_if_blank":
467	        return None if _is_blank(value) else value
468	    if op == "number":
469	        if _is_blank(value):
470	            return None
471	        number = Decimal(value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) else str(value))
472	        if field is not None and field.is_numeric and field.scale > 0:
473	            return float(number)
474	        return int(number) if number == number.to_integral_value() else float(number)
475	    if op == "date":
476	        if _is_blank(value) or _norm(value) in arg["nulls"]:
477	            return None
478	        return datetime.strptime(_norm(value), arg["in"]).strftime(arg["out"])
479	    if op == "map":
480	        return arg["values"].get(_norm(value), arg["default"])
481	    if op == "default":
482	        return arg if value is None else value
483	    if op == "substring":
484	        if not isinstance(value, str):
485	            return value
486	        start = arg["start"] - 1
487	        return value[start : start + arg["length"]]
488	    if op == "lstrip_zeros":
489	        if not isinstance(value, str):
490	            return value
491	        stripped = value.lstrip("0")
492	        return "0" if value and not stripped else stripped
493	    if op == "pad":
494	        if value is None:
495	            return None
496	        text = str(value)
497	        if arg["side"] == "left":
498	            return text.rjust(arg["length"], arg["char"])
499	        return text.ljust(arg["length"], arg["char"])
500	    if op == "boolean":
501	        key = _norm(value)
502	        if key in arg["true"]:
503	            return True
504	        if key in arg["false"]:
505	            return False
506	        return arg["default"]
507	    if op == "multiply":
508	        return _arith(value, lambda d: d * arg)
509	    if op == "divide":
510	        return _arith(value, lambda d: d / arg)
511	    if op == "round":
512	        return _arith(value, lambda d: d.quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-arg), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
513	    if op == "replace":
514	        return None if value is None else re.sub(arg["pattern"], arg["with"], str(value))
515	    if op == "_truncate":
516	        return value[:arg] if isinstance(value, str) else value
517	    if op == "_abs":
518	        return abs(value) if isinstance(value, (Decimal, int, float)) else value
519	    if op == "_blank_as_empty":
520	        return "" if value is None else value
521	    raise MappingError(f"Unknown step {op}")
522	
523	
524	def check_passes(value: Any, op: str, arg: Any) -> bool:
525	    """True when ``value`` satisfies one check. Only ``required`` fails on a null."""
526	    if op == "required":
527	        return not _is_blank(value)
528	    if _is_blank(value):
529	        return True
530	    if op == "min_length":
531	        return len(str(value)) >= arg
532	    if op == "max_length":
533	        return len(str(value)) <= arg
534	    if op in ("min", "max"):
535	        try:
536	            number = Decimal(str(value).strip())
537	        except Exception:
538	            return False
539	        return number >= arg if op == "min" else number <= arg
540	    if op == "pattern":
541	        return re.fullmatch(str(arg), str(value)) is not None
542	    if op in ("unique", "min_items", "max_items", "unique_items"):
543	        return True  # evaluated on arrays or across records
544	    if op == "allowed":
545	        return any(_equal(value, a) if not isinstance(value, bool) else value == a for a in arg)
546	    raise MappingError(f"Unknown check {op}")
547	
548	
549	def _run_steps(value: Any, rule: Rule, field: Optional[Field]) -> Any:
550	    for op, arg in rule.steps:
551	        value = apply_step(value, op, arg, field)
552	    return value
553	
554	
555	def _transform(value: Any, rule: Rule, field: Optional[Field]) -> Any:
556	    try:
557	        return _run_steps(value, rule, field)
558	    except Exception:
559	        if rule.on_error == "reject":
560	            raise RuleRejected(rule.id)
561	        if rule.on_error == "null":
562	            return None
563	        raise
564

566	def _identity(value: Any) -> str:
567	    return repr(sorted(value.items())) if isinstance(value, dict) else repr(value)
568	
569	
570	def _dedupe(values: List[Any]) -> List[Any]:
571	    seen, out = set(), []
572	    for value in values:
573	        key = _identity(value)
574	        if key not in seen:
575	            seen.add(key)
576	            out.append(value)
577	    return out
578	
579	
580	def _finish_array(rule: Rule, items: List[Any], blank) -> List[Any]:
581	    if rule.drop_blank:
582	        items = [item for item in items if not blank(item)]
583	    if rule.distinct:
584	        items = _dedupe(items)
585	    if rule.array_op == "drop_last":
586	        items = items[:-1]
587	    elif rule.array_op == "first_only":
588	        items = items[:1]
589	    return items
590	
591	
592	def _failed_checks(rule: Rule, value: Any) -> List[str]:
593	    if isinstance(value, list):
594	        failed = []
595	        for op, arg in rule.checks:
596	            if op == "required":
597	                ok = bool(value)
598	            elif op == "min_items":
599	                ok = len(value) >= arg
600	            elif op == "max_items":
601	                ok = len(value) <= arg
602	            elif op == "unique_items":
603	                ok = len({_identity(v) for v in value}) == len(value)
604	            else:
605	                ok = all(check_passes(item, op, arg) for item in value)
606	            if not ok:
607	                failed.append(f"{rule.id}:{op}")
608	        return failed
609	    return [f"{rule.id}:{op}" for op, arg in rule.checks if not check_passes(value, op, arg)]
610

612	def evaluate_rule(record: Dict[str, Any], rule: Rule, layout: Layout) -> Tuple[Any, List[str]]:
613	    """Return (output value, failed check ids). Raises RuleRejected for rejected input."""
614	    if rule.when is not None and not condition_matches(record, rule.when):
615	        return rule.when_else, []
616	
617	    if rule.items:
618	        return _evaluate_items(record, rule, layout)
619	    if rule.is_constant:
620	        value: Any = _transform(rule.value, rule, None)
621	    elif rule.is_concat:
622	        parts = [_norm(record[s]) if rule.trim_parts else str(record[s]) for s in rule.sources]
623	        if rule.parts_op == "reverse":
624	            parts = parts[::-1]
625	        elif rule.parts_op == "drop_last":
626	            parts = parts[:-1]
627	        value = _transform(rule.separator.join(parts), rule, None)
628	    else:
629	        field = layout.field(rule.source)
630	        raw = record[rule.source]
631	        if field.occurs > 1:
632	            count = len(raw)
633	            items = [_transform(raw[(i + rule.shift) % count], rule, field) for i in range(count)]
634	            value = _finish_array(rule, items, lambda v: v in (None, ""))
635	        else:
636	            value = _transform(raw, rule, field)
637	    return value, _failed_checks(rule, value)
638	
639	
640	def _evaluate_items(record: Dict[str, Any], rule: Rule, layout: Layout) -> Tuple[Any, List[str]]:
641	    count = layout.field(rule.items[0][1].source).occurs
642	    objects: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
643	    failed: List[str] = []
644	    members = [
645	        (name, replace(sub, on_error=rule.on_error), layout.field(sub.source))
646	        for name, sub in rule.items
647	    ]
648	    for index in range(count):
649	        obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
650	        for name, sub, field in members:
651	            raw = record[sub.source][(index + sub.shift) % count]
652	            obj[name] = _transform(raw, sub, field)
653	        objects.append(obj)
654	    objects = _finish_array(rule, objects, lambda o: all(v in (None, "") for v in o.values()))
655	    for obj in objects:
656	        for name, sub in rule.items:
657	            failed.extend(_failed_checks(sub, obj[name]))
658	    failed.extend(_failed_checks(rule, objects))
659	    return objects, sorted(set(failed))

662	def _set_path(doc: Dict[str, Any], path: str, value: Any) -> None:

689	    try:

698	    key_rule = mapping.key_rule

714	    if reasons:

725	
726	    Returns the document, or a marker document:
727	      ``{"__filtered__": true, <key>}``           record is excluded by the mapping filter
728	      ``{"__rejected__": ["R2:required"], <key>}`` record fails a validation
729	    """

1	"""Parse COBOL copybooks into fixed-length record layouts.
2	
3	Supported:
4	  * elementary items with PIC X / A / 9, including S (sign) and V (implied decimal)
5	  * USAGE DISPLAY (zoned decimal), COMP-3 / PACKED-DECIMAL, and binary
6	    COMP / COMP-4 / COMP-5 / BINARY (big-endian, up to 18 digits)
7	  * OCCURS n TIMES on elementary items
8	  * level-88 condition names (ignored, they occupy no storage)
9	
10	Not yet supported (raises CopybookError so a layout is never silently misread):
11	  REDEFINES, OCCURS on group items, OCCURS DEPENDING ON, floating point
12	  COMP-1/COMP-2, and edited pictures.
13	"""
14	
15	from __future__ import annotations
16	
17	import re
18	from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
19	from typing import Iterator, List, Tuple
20	
21	
22	class CopybookError(ValueError):
23	    """Raised when a copybook cannot be parsed into a supported layout."""
24	
25	
26	_REPEAT = re.compile(r"([XA9])\((\d+)\)")
27	_ENTRY = re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]*)(.*)$")
28	_PIC = re.compile(r"\bPIC(?:TURE)?\s+(?:IS\s+)?(\S+)")
29	_OCCURS = re.compile(r"\bOCCURS\s+(\d+)")
30	_PACKED = re.compile(r"\b(?:COMP-3|COMPUTATIONAL-3|PACKED-DECIMAL)\b")
31	_FLOAT = re.compile(r"\b(?:COMP-[12]|COMPUTATIONAL-[12])\b")
32	_BINARY = re.compile(r"\b(?:COMP|COMP-[45]|COMPUTATIONAL|COMPUTATIONAL-[45]|BINARY)\b")
33	
34	
35	@dataclass(frozen=True)
36	class Field:
37	    """One elementary item of a fixed-length record."""
38	
39	    name: str
40	    kind: str  # "X" alphanumeric, "9" zoned decimal, "P" packed (COMP-3), "B" binary (COMP)
41	    int_digits: int  # for "X": the character length
42	    scale: int = 0
43	    signed: bool = False
44	    occurs: int = 1
45	    offset: int = 0
46	    little_endian: bool = False  # only set by the byte-order mutant
47	
48	    @property
49	    def total_digits(self) -> int:
50	        return self.int_digits + self.scale
51	
52	    @property
53	    def item_length(self) -> int:
54	        """Bytes used by one occurrence."""
55	        if self.kind == "X":
56	            return self.int_digits
57	        if self.kind == "9":
58	            return self.total_digits
59	        if self.kind == "B":
60	            return 2 if self.total_digits <= 4 else 4 if self.total_digits <= 9 else 8
61	        return self.total_digits // 2 + 1
62	
63	    @property
64	    def length(self) -> int:
65	        """Bytes used by all occurrences."""
66	        return self.item_length * self.occurs
67	
68	    @property
69	    def is_numeric(self) -> bool:
70	        return self.kind in ("9", "P", "B")
71	
72	    def describe(self) -> str:
73	        if self.kind == "X":
74	            pic = f"X({self.int_digits})"
75	        else:
76	            pic = ("S" if self.signed else "") + f"9({self.int_digits})"
77	            if self.scale:
78	                pic += f"V9({self.scale})"
79	            if self.kind == "P":
80	                pic += " COMP-3"
81	            elif self.kind == "B":
82	                pic += " COMP"
83	        if self.occurs > 1:
84	            pic += f" OCCURS {self.occurs}"
85	        return pic
86	
87	
88	@dataclass(frozen=True)
89	class Layout:
90	    """An ordered set of fields describing one fixed-length record."""
91	
92	    fields: Tuple[Field, ...]
93	    record_length: int
94	
95	    def field(self, name: str) -> Field:
96	        for f in self.fields:
97	            if f.name == name:
98	                return f
99	        raise KeyError(name)
100	
101	    def names(self) -> List[str]:
102	        return [f.name for f in self.fields]
103	
104	    def with_field(self, name: str, **changes) -> "Layout":
105	        """Return a copy of the layout with one field changed (used by mutants)."""
106	        return Layout(
107	            tuple(replace(f, **changes) if f.name == name else f for f in self.fields),
108	            self.record_length,
109	        )
110	
111	
112	def _statements(text: str) -> Iterator[str]:
113	    lines = []
114	    for raw in text.splitlines():
115	        line = raw.rstrip()
116	        if re.match(r"^\d{6}", line):  # fixed-format sequence area
117	            line = line[6:]
118	        stripped = line.strip()
119	        if not stripped or stripped[0] in "*/":
120	            continue
121	        lines.append(stripped)
122	    joined = " ".join(lines).upper()
123	    for stmt in re.split(r"\.(?=\s|$)", joined):
124	        stmt = " ".join(stmt.split())
125	        if stmt:
126	            yield stmt
127	
128	
129	def _picture(name: str, pic: str, usage: str) -> Tuple[str, int, int, bool]:
130	    expanded = _REPEAT.sub(lambda m: m.group(1) * int(m.group(2)), pic)
131	    if expanded and set(expanded) <= {"X", "A"}:
132	        if usage != "9":
133	            raise CopybookError(f"{name}: COMP usage is only valid on numeric pictures")
134	        return "X", len(expanded), 0, False
135	    signed = expanded.startswith("S")
136	    body = expanded[1:] if signed else expanded
137	    if not body.replace("V", "") or set(body) - {"9", "V"} or body.count("V") > 1:
138	        raise CopybookError(f"{name}: unsupported picture clause {pic!r}")
139	    left, _, right = body.partition("V")
140	    if usage == "B" and len(left) + len(right) > 18:
141	        raise CopybookError(f"{name}: binary fields over 18 digits are not supported")
142	    return usage, len(left), len(right), signed
143	
144	
145	def parse_copybook(text: str) -> Layout:
146	    """Parse copybook source text into a Layout with byte offsets assigned."""
147	    fields: List[Field] = []
148	    offset = 0
149	    fillers = 0
150	    seen = set()
151	    for stmt in _statements(text):
152	        match = _ENTRY.match(stmt)
153	        if not match:
154	            raise CopybookError(f"Cannot parse copybook statement: {stmt!r}")
155	        level, name, rest = int(match.group(1)), match.group(2), match.group(3)
156	        words = rest.split()
157	        if level == 88:
158	            continue
159	        if level == 66 or "RENAMES" in words:
160	            raise CopybookError(f"{name}: RENAMES is not supported")
161	        if "REDEFINES" in words:
162	            raise CopybookError(f"{name}: REDEFINES is not supported yet")
163	        if "DEPENDING" in words:
164	            raise CopybookError(f"{name}: OCCURS DEPENDING ON is not supported yet")
165	        pic = _PIC.search(rest)
166	        occurs = _OCCURS.search(rest)
167	        if pic is None:
168	            if occurs:
169	                raise CopybookError(f"{name}: OCCURS on group items is not supported yet")
170	            continue  # group item, no storage of its own
171	        if _PACKED.search(rest):
172	            usage = "P"
173	        elif _FLOAT.search(rest):
174	            raise CopybookError(f"{name}: floating point COMP-1/COMP-2 is not supported yet")
175	        elif _BINARY.search(rest):
176	            usage = "B"
177	        else:
178	            usage = "9"
179	        kind, int_digits, scale, signed = _picture(name, pic.group(1), usage)
180	        if name == "FILLER":
181	            fillers += 1
182	            name = f"FILLER-{fillers}"
183	        if name in seen:
184	            raise CopybookError(f"Duplicate field name {name}")
185	        seen.add(name)
186	        field = Field(
187	            name=name,
188	            kind=kind,
189	            int_digits=int_digits,
190	            scale=scale,
191	            signed=signed,
192	            occurs=int(occurs.group(1)) if occurs else 1,
193	            offset=offset,
194	        )
195	        if field.occurs < 1:
196	            raise CopybookError(f"{name}: OCCURS must be at least 1")
197	        fields.append(field)
198	        offset += field.length
199	    if not fields:
200	        raise CopybookError("Copybook contains no elementary fields")
201	    return Layout(tuple(fields), offset)
202	
203	
204	def load_copybook(path) -> Layout:
205	    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
206	        return parse_copybook(handle.read())

1	"""Witness generation and minimization.
2	
3	1. For every field, build candidate values from the rules that read it: the
4	   formats it must parse (dates, codes, booleans, numbers in text), the
5	   boundaries of its validations (lengths, ranges, patterns, allowed values),
6	   blanks, duplicates and element counts for arrays, and the values that switch
7	   conditions and filters on and off.
8	2. Build a valid baseline record (one that loads cleanly and exercises every
9	   conditional rule it can), plus one baseline per condition outcome, then vary
10	   one field at a time. Every candidate is valid for the copybook by
11	   construction, and the reference pipeline must accept, reject or filter it
12	   without crashing.
13	3. Run the reference pipeline and every mutant on every candidate. A candidate
14	   "kills" a mutant when the outputs differ.
15	4. Select the smallest set of candidates that kills every killable mutant
16	   (greedy set cover). Those are the witness records.
17	"""
18	
19	from __future__ import annotations
20	
21	from collections import defaultdict
22	from dataclasses import dataclass, field as dc_field
23	from datetime import date
24	from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
25	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Set
26	
27	from . import regexgen
28	from .codec import CodecError, decode_record, encode_record
29	from .copybook import Field, Layout
30	from .mapping import (
31	    ARRAY_CHECKS, FILTERED, REJECTED, Condition, Mapping, Rule, apply_step, assemble,
32	    check_passes, condition_matches, is_filtered, rule_outcome,
33	)
34	from .mutants import Mutant, generate_mutants, output_quantum
35	from .pipeline import ERROR_KEY, canonical, is_error, run_pipeline
36	
37	_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
38	_SAMPLE_DATES = (date(2024, 1, 31), date(2024, 3, 5), date(1999, 12, 9))
39	
40	
41	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- field usage
42	
43	
44	@dataclass
45	class FieldUsage:
46	    rules: List[Rule] = dc_field(default_factory=list)  # rules (or object members) reading it alone
47	    conditions: List[Condition] = dc_field(default_factory=list)
48	    in_concat: bool = False
49	
50	
51	def field_usage(mapping: Mapping) -> Dict[str, FieldUsage]:
52	    usage: Dict[str, FieldUsage] = defaultdict(FieldUsage)
53	    if mapping.filter is not None:
54	        usage[mapping.filter.field].conditions.append(mapping.filter)
55	    for rule in mapping.rules:
56	        if rule.when is not None:
57	            usage[rule.when.field].conditions.append(rule.when)
58	        if rule.items:
59	            for _, sub in rule.items:
60	                usage[sub.source].rules.append(sub)
61	        elif rule.is_concat:
62	            for name in rule.sources:
63	                usage[name].in_concat = True
64	        elif rule.source:
65	            usage[rule.source].rules.append(rule)
66	    return usage
67	
68	
69	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- candidate values
70	
71	
72	def _rotated_text(length: int, seed: int) -> str:
73	    shift = seed % len(_ALPHABET)
74	    letters = _ALPHABET[shift:] + _ALPHABET[:shift]
75	    return (letters * (length // len(letters) + 1))[:length]
76	
77	
78	def _digits(length: int, seed: int) -> str:
79	    return "".join(str((seed + i) % 9 + 1) for i in range(length))
80	
81	
82	def _numeric_pattern(field: Field, seed: int) -> Decimal:
83	    whole = _digits(field.int_digits, seed) or "0"
84	    frac = _digits(field.scale, seed + 4)
85	    return Decimal(f"{whole}.{frac}" if frac else whole)
86	
87	
88	def _dedupe(values: Sequence[Any]) -> List[Any]:
89	    seen, out = set(), []
90	    for value in values:
91	        key = repr(value)
92	        if key not in seen:
93	            seen.add(key)
94	            out.append(value)
95	    return out
96	
97	
98	def _arith_factor(rule: Rule) -> Decimal:
99	    factor = Decimal(1)
100	    for op, arg in rule.steps:
101	        if op == "multiply":
102	            factor *= arg
103	        elif op == "divide":
104	            factor /= arg
105	    return factor
106	
107	
108	def _value_ok(value: Any, field: Field, rules: Sequence[Rule]) -> bool:
109	    """Does a single value transform cleanly and pass every scalar check of its rules?"""
110	    for rule in rules:
111	        try:
112	            out = value
113	            for op, arg in rule.steps:
114	                out = apply_step(out, op, arg, field)
115	        except Exception:
116	            return False
117	        for op, arg in rule.checks:
118	            if op not in ARRAY_CHECKS and op != "required" and not check_passes(out, op, arg):
119	                return False
120	            if op == "required" and not check_passes(out, op, arg) and field.occurs == 1:
121	                return False
122	    return True
123	
124	
125	def _text_specials(size: int, usage: FieldUsage, seed: int, variant: int) -> List[str]:
126	    out: List[str] = []
127	    for rule in usage.rules:
128	        for op, arg in rule.steps:
129	            if op == "date":
130	                ordered = _SAMPLE_DATES[variant % 3:] + _SAMPLE_DATES[:variant % 3]
131	                out += [d.strftime(arg["in"]) for d in ordered] + list(arg["nulls"])
132	            elif op == "map":
133	                keys = list(arg["values"])
134	                out += keys[variant % len(keys):] + keys[:variant % len(keys)]
135	                out.append(_rotated_text(size, seed + 11))
136	            elif op == "boolean":
137	                out += arg["true"] + arg["false"] + ["?"]
138	            elif op == "lstrip_zeros":
139	                out += ["00" + _digits(max(1, size - 2), seed), "0" * size]
140	            elif op == "replace":
141	                sample = regexgen.matching(arg["pattern"], variant)
142	                if sample:
143	                    out += [sample, f"{_rotated_text(2, seed)}{sample}"]
144	            elif op == "number":
145	                out += [_digits(size, seed), "0" * (size - 1) + "7", "1"]
146	        factor = _arith_factor(rule)
147	        for op, arg in rule.checks:
148	            if op == "pattern":
149	                match = regexgen.matching(str(arg), variant)
150	                out += [m for m in (match, regexgen.matching(str(arg), variant + 1),
151	                                    regexgen.near_miss(str(arg), match)) if m]
152	            elif op == "allowed":
153	                values = [str(a) for a in arg]
154	                out += values[variant % len(values):] + values[:variant % len(values)]
155	                out.append(_rotated_text(min(size, 3), seed + 13))
156	            elif op in ("min_length", "max_length"):
157	                out += [_rotated_text(n, seed) for n in (arg, arg - 1, arg + 1) if 0 < n <= size]
158	            elif op in ("min", "max") and any(o == "number" for o, _ in rule.steps):
159	                bound = arg / factor if factor else arg
160	                for value in (bound, bound - 1, bound + 1):
161	                    if value >= 0 and value == value.to_integral_value():
162	                        out.append(str(int(value)).zfill(size))
163	        ops = [op for op, _ in rule.steps]
164	        if "upper" in ops:
165	            out += [v.lower() for v in out if v.lower() != v]
166	        if "lower" in ops:
167	            out += [v.upper() for v in out if v.upper() != v]
168	    for condition in usage.conditions:
169	        out += [str(v) for v in condition.values] + [""]
170	    return out
171	
172	
173	def _numeric_specials(field: Field, usage: FieldUsage, quantum: Decimal) -> List[Decimal]:
174	    out: List[Decimal] = []
175	    for rule in usage.rules:
176	        factor = _arith_factor(rule)
177	        step = output_quantum(rule, field)
178	        for op, arg in rule.checks:
179	            if op in ("min", "max"):
180	                for target in (arg, arg - step, arg + step, arg - step / 2, arg + step / 2):
181	                    try:
182	                        out.append((target / factor).quantize(quantum))
183	                    except InvalidOperation:
184	                        continue
185	            elif op == "allowed":
186	                out += [Decimal(str(a)) for a in arg if _is_number(a)]
187	        for op, arg in rule.steps:
188	            if op in ("map", "boolean"):
189	                keys = list(arg["values"]) if op == "map" else arg["true"] + arg["false"]
190	                out += [Decimal(k) for k in keys if _is_number(k)]
191	    for condition in usage.conditions:
192	        out += [Decimal(str(v)) for v in condition.values if _is_number(v)]
193	    return out
194	
195	
196	def _is_number(value: Any) -> bool:
197	    try:
198	        Decimal(str(value))
199	        return True
200	    except InvalidOperation:
201	        return False
202	
203	
204	def item_candidates(field: Field, usage: FieldUsage, seed: int, variant: int = 0) -> List[Any]:
205	    """Candidate values for one occurrence of a field; the first is the preferred value."""
206	    if field.kind == "X":
207	        size = field.item_length
208	        primary = _rotated_text(size, seed)
209	        generic = [primary, primary.lower(), _rotated_text(max(1, size // 2), seed + 7), ""]
210	        values = [v for v in _dedupe(_text_specials(size, usage, seed, variant) + generic)
211	                  if len(v) <= size]
212	    else:
213	        quantum = Decimal(1).scaleb(-field.scale)
214	        largest = Decimal(10) ** field.int_digits - quantum
215	        pattern = _numeric_pattern(field, seed)
216	        generic = [pattern, Decimal(0), Decimal(1) if field.int_digits else quantum, largest]
217	        if field.signed:
218	            generic.insert(1, -pattern)
219	        lowest = -largest if field.signed else Decimal(0)
220	        values = _dedupe(
221	            v.quantize(quantum)
222	            for v in _numeric_specials(field, usage, quantum) + generic
223	            if lowest <= v <= largest
224	        )
225	    valid = [v for v in values if _value_ok(v, field, usage.rules)]
226	    return _dedupe(valid[:1] + values) if valid else values
227	
228	
229	def array_structures(field: Field, usage: FieldUsage, seed: int) -> List[List[Any]]:
230	    """Element layouts for an OCCURS field, always in the same order and count:
231	    all filled, last blank, every shorter element count, duplicates, duplicate across a gap.
232	    Parallel OCCURS fields use the same index so their blanks and duplicates line up."""
233	    items = item_candidates(field, usage, seed)
234	    blank: Any = "" if field.kind == "X" else Decimal(0).quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-field.scale))
235	    distinct = _dedupe(
236	        item_candidates(field, usage, seed + 5 * (i + 1), variant=i)[0] for i in range(field.occurs)
237	    )
238	    while len(distinct) < field.occurs:  # pad with any other valid items
239	        extra = [v for v in items if v not in distinct and _value_ok(v, field, usage.rules)]
240	        distinct.append(extra[0] if extra else blank)
241	    n = field.occurs
242	    lists = [distinct, distinct[:-1] + [blank]]
243	    lists += [distinct[:k] + [blank] * (n - k) for k in range(n - 1)]  # every element count
244	    lists.append(([distinct[0], distinct[0]] + distinct[1:])[:n])  # adjacent duplicate
245	    lists.append(([distinct[0], blank, distinct[0]] + distinct[1:])[:n])  # duplicate across a gap
246	    return lists
247	
248	
249	def value_candidates(field: Field, usage: FieldUsage, seed: int) -> List[Any]:
250	    """Candidate values for a whole field (lists for OCCURS fields)."""
251	    items = item_candidates(field, usage, seed)
252	    if field.occurs == 1:
253	        return items
254	    lists = array_structures(field, usage, seed)
255	    lists += [[item] * field.occurs for item in items]
256	    return _dedupe(lists)

262	def _uniquify(field: Field, value: Any, index: int) -> Any:
263	    """Make a key value unique per record while keeping its shape (case, padding, sign)."""
264	    if field.kind == "X":
265	        core = str(value or "").rstrip()
266	        if not core.strip():
267	            return None  # blank keys are not usable
268	        tag = f"{index:03d}"
269	        if len(core) > len(tag):
270	            return core[: len(core) - len(tag)] + tag
271	        return (core + tag)[: field.item_length]
272	    return value + index if value >= 0 else value - index

275	@dataclass
276	class Candidate:
277	    record: Dict[str, Any]
278	    data: bytes
279	    expected: Dict[str, Any]
280	    kills: Set[str] = dc_field(default_factory=set)
281	
282	    @property
283	    def outcome(self) -> str:
284	        if FILTERED in self.expected:
285	            return "filtered"
286	        if REJECTED in self.expected:
287	            return "rejected"
288	        return "loaded"

292	class ForgeResult:
293	    layout: Layout
294	    mapping: Mapping
295	    mutants: List[Mutant]
296	    witnesses: List[Candidate]
297	    survivors: List[Mutant]
298	    pool_size: int

300	    @property
301	    def killed(self) -> Set[str]:
302	        return set().union(*(w.kills for w in self.witnesses)) if self.witnesses else set()
303	
304	    @property
305	    def score(self) -> float:
306	        return len(self.killed) / len(self.mutants) if self.mutants else 1.0

309	def _badness(record: Dict[str, Any], layout: Layout, mapping: Mapping) -> float:
310	    """Lower is better: loads cleanly and exercises as many conditional rules as possible."""
311	    try:
312	        data = encode_record(layout, record)
313	    except CodecError:
314	        return float("inf")
315	    doc = run_pipeline(data, layout, mapping)
316	    if is_error(doc):
317	        return 1e6
318	    if FILTERED in doc:
319	        return 1e4
320	    score = 100.0 * len(doc.get(REJECTED, []))
321	    score += sum(1 for r in mapping.rules if r.when is not None and not condition_matches(record, r.when))
322	    return score

325	def _repair(base: Dict[str, Any], candidates: Dict[str, List[Any]], layout: Layout,
326	            mapping: Mapping, fixed: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
327	    best = dict(base)
328	    best_score = _badness(best, layout, mapping)
329	    for _ in range(3):
330	        improved = False
331	        for name, values in candidates.items():
332	            if name in fixed or best_score == 0:
333	                continue
334	            for value in values:
335	                trial = dict(best)
336	                trial[name] = value
337	                score = _badness(trial, layout, mapping)
338	                if score < best_score:
339	                    best, best_score, improved = trial, score, True
340	        if not improved:
341	            break
342	    return best
343	
344	
345	def _condition_bases(base, candidates, layout, mapping) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
346	    """One extra baseline per condition, with the condition's outcome flipped."""
347	    conditions = [r.when for r in mapping.rules if r.when is not None]
348	    if mapping.filter is not None:
349	        conditions.append(mapping.filter)
350	    bases = []
351	    for condition in conditions:
352	        current = condition_matches(base, condition)
353	        for value in candidates[condition.field]:
354	            trial = dict(base)
355	            trial[condition.field] = value
356	            if condition_matches(trial, condition) != current:
357	                bases.append(_repair(trial, candidates, layout, mapping, {condition.field}))
358	                break
359	    return bases

362	def build_pool(layout: Layout, mapping: Mapping) -> List[Candidate]:
363	    usage = field_usage(mapping)
364	    candidates = {
365	        f.name: value_candidates(f, usage[f.name], seed=index * 7)
366	        for index, f in enumerate(layout.fields)
367	    }
368	    base = _repair({n: v[0] for n, v in candidates.items()}, candidates, layout, mapping, set())
369	    bases = [base] + _condition_bases(base, candidates, layout, mapping)
370	
371	    records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = list(bases)
372	    seeds = {f.name: index * 7 for index, f in enumerate(layout.fields)}
373	    for rule in mapping.rules:  # line up blanks and duplicates across object members
374	        if not rule.items:
375	            continue
376	        members = [sub.source for _, sub in rule.items]
377	        shapes = {m: array_structures(layout.field(m), usage[m], seeds[m]) for m in members}
378	        for start in bases:
379	            for index in range(len(shapes[members[0]])):
380	                variant = dict(start)
381	                for member in members:
382	                    variant[member] = shapes[member][index]
383	                records.append(variant)
384	    width = max(len(values) for values in candidates.values())
385	    for k in range(1, width):  # "rich" records that change every field at once
386	        records.append({name: values[k % len(values)] for name, values in candidates.items()})
387	    for start in bases:  # one-field variations of every baseline
388	        for name, values in candidates.items():
389	            for value in values:
390	                if value != start[name]:
391	                    variant = dict(start)
392	                    variant[name] = value
393	                    records.append(variant)
394	
395	    key_field = layout.field(mapping.key_rule.source) if mapping.key_rule else None
396	    pool: List[Candidate] = []
397	    seen, used_keys = set(), set()
398	    blank_key_loaded = False
399	    for index, record in enumerate(records):
400	        blank_key = False
401	        if key_field is not None:
402	            record = dict(record)
403	            unique = _uniquify(key_field, record[key_field.name], index)
404	            if unique is None:  # blank keys are kept to exercise key validations
405	                unique, blank_key = "", True
406	            elif unique in used_keys:
407	                continue
408	            record[key_field.name] = unique
409	        try:
410	            data = encode_record(layout, record)
411	        except CodecError:
412	            continue
413	        if data in seen:
414	            continue
415	        expected = run_pipeline(data, layout, mapping)
416	        if is_error(expected):  # input the specification itself cannot handle
417	            continue
418	        loaded = FILTERED not in expected and REJECTED not in expected
419	        if blank_key and loaded:  # at most one loaded document may have a blank key
420	            if blank_key_loaded:
421	                continue
422	            blank_key_loaded = True
423	        seen.add(data)
424	        if key_field is not None and not blank_key:
425	            used_keys.add(record[key_field.name])
426	        pool.append(Candidate(decode_record(layout, data), data, expected))
427	    return pool
428

430	class _CachedRecord:
431	    """Per-rule outcomes of the specification for one record, reused across mutants.
432	
433	    Mutants share every unchanged Rule object with the specification, so only rules
434	    that are not the identical object (and the filter) are evaluated again.
435	    """
436	
437	    def __init__(self, record: Dict[str, Any], layout: Layout, mapping: Mapping):
438	        self.record, self.layout = record, layout
439	        self.outcomes: Dict[int, Any] = {}
440	        for rule in mapping.rules:
441	            self._outcome(rule)
442	
443	    def _outcome(self, rule: Rule):
444	        key = id(rule)
445	        if key not in self.outcomes:
446	            try:
447	                self.outcomes[key] = (rule, rule_outcome(self.record, rule, self.layout))
448	            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - a crash is an observable outcome
449	                self.outcomes[key] = (rule, exc)
450	        return self.outcomes[key][1]
451	
452	    def run(self, mapping: Mapping) -> Dict[str, Any]:
453	        try:
454	            filtered = is_filtered(self.record, mapping)
455	            rules = ([mapping.key_rule] if mapping.key_rule else []) if filtered else mapping.rules
456	            outcomes = {}
457	            for rule in rules:
458	                outcome = self._outcome(rule)
459	                if isinstance(outcome, Exception):
460	                    if filtered:  # the key is optional on a filtered marker
461	                        outcome = (False, None, [])
462	                    else:
463	                        raise outcome
464	                outcomes[rule.id] = outcome
465	            return assemble(mapping, outcomes, filtered)
466	        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
467	            return {ERROR_KEY: type(exc).__name__}
468	
469	
470	def forge(layout: Layout, mapping: Mapping) -> ForgeResult:
471	    """Generate the minimal witness set for a copybook and mapping."""
472	    mutants = generate_mutants(layout, mapping)
473	    pool = build_pool(layout, mapping)
474	    for candidate in pool:
475	        reference = canonical(candidate.expected)
476	        cached = _CachedRecord(candidate.record, layout, mapping)
477	        for mutant in mutants:
478	            if mutant.layout is layout:  # same decoding: recompute only the changed rule
479	                output = cached.run(mutant.mapping)
480	            else:
481	                output = run_pipeline(candidate.data, mutant.layout, mutant.mapping)
482	            if canonical(output) != reference:
483	                candidate.kills.add(mutant.id)
484	
485	    remaining = set().union(*(c.kills for c in pool)) if pool else set()
486	    selected: List[Candidate] = []
487	    while remaining:
488	        best = max(pool, key=lambda c: (len(c.kills & remaining), c.outcome == "loaded"))
489	        gained = best.kills & remaining
490	        if not gained:
491	            break
492	        selected.append(best)
493	        remaining -= gained
494	
495	    killed = set().union(*(c.kills for c in selected)) if selected else set()
496	    survivors = [m for m in mutants if m.id not in killed]
497	    return ForgeResult(layout, mapping, mutants, selected, survivors, len(pool))

1	"""Check a real pipeline's output for the witness records against the specification.
2	
3	What is checked:
4	  * every record that should load is present, and nothing else is loaded
5	  * records that should be rejected or filtered out are not loaded
6	  * (optional) the reject file holds exactly the records that should be rejected
7	  * duplicate output documents, and duplicate values for rules with a ``unique`` check
8	  * every field, array and nested object: values, types, missing or extra paths,
9	    item counts, missing, extra and duplicate items, item order
10	"""
11	
12	from __future__ import annotations
13	
14	import re
15	from collections import Counter
16	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
17	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
18	
19	from .codec import split_records
20	from .copybook import Layout
21	from .mapping import FILTERED, REJECTED, Mapping, get_path
22	from .pipeline import json_ready, run_pipeline
23	
24	_MISSING = object()
25	
26	
27	@dataclass
28	class Mismatch:
29	    record: Optional[int]
30	    path: str
31	    rule_id: Optional[str]
32	    expected: Any
33	    actual: Any
34	    detail: str = ""
35	
36	
37	@dataclass
38	class VerifyResult:
39	    records: int
40	    loaded: int = 0
41	    rejected: int = 0
42	    filtered: int = 0
43	    mismatches: List[Mismatch] = field(default_factory=list)
44	    problems: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
45	
46	    @property
47	    def ok(self) -> bool:
48	        return not self.mismatches and not self.problems
49	
50	
51	def _same(expected: Any, actual: Any) -> bool:
52	    """Equal values of compatible types (12 == 12.0 is fine; "12" vs 12 or True vs 1 is not)."""
53	    if isinstance(expected, bool) or isinstance(actual, bool):
54	        return type(expected) is type(actual) and expected == actual
55	    if isinstance(expected, (int, float)) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
56	        return expected == actual
57	    return type(expected) is type(actual) and expected == actual
58	
59	
60	def _token(value: Any) -> str:
61	    return repr(sorted(value.items())) if isinstance(value, dict) else repr(value)
62	
63	
64	def _show(value: Any) -> Any:
65	    return "<missing>" if value is _MISSING else value
66	
67	
68	def _diff(expected: Any, actual: Any, path: str, out: List[Tuple[str, Any, Any, str]]) -> None:
69	    if isinstance(expected, dict) and isinstance(actual, dict):
70	        for key in sorted(set(expected) | set(actual)):
71	            _diff(expected.get(key, _MISSING), actual.get(key, _MISSING),
72	                  f"{path}.{key}" if path else key, out)
73	        return
74	    if isinstance(expected, list) and isinstance(actual, list):
75	        _diff_list(expected, actual, path, out)
76	        return
77	    if expected is _MISSING or actual is _MISSING:
78	        detail = "path missing from output" if actual is _MISSING else "unexpected path in output"
79	        out.append((path, _show(expected), _show(actual), detail))
80	    elif not _same(expected, actual):
81	        detail = "" if type(expected) is type(actual) else (
82	            f"type {type(expected).__name__} expected, got {type(actual).__name__}")
83	        out.append((path, expected, actual, detail))
84	
85	
86	def _diff_list(expected: list, actual: list, path: str, out) -> None:
87	    if len(expected) != len(actual):
88	        out.append((path, f"{len(expected)} items", f"{len(actual)} items", "item count differs"))
89	    if any(isinstance(v, (dict, list)) for v in expected + actual):
90	        for index in range(max(len(expected), len(actual))):
91	            e = expected[index] if index < len(expected) else _MISSING
92	            a = actual[index] if index < len(actual) else _MISSING
93	            if e is _MISSING or a is _MISSING:
94	                out.append((f"{path}[{index}]", _show(e), _show(a),
95	                            "item missing" if a is _MISSING else "unexpected item"))
96	            else:
97	                _diff(e, a, f"{path}[{index}]", out)
98	        return
99	    want, got = Counter(_token(v) for v in expected), Counter(_token(v) for v in actual)
100	    by_token = {_token(v): v for v in expected + actual}
101	    for token in sorted(set(want) | set(got)):
102	        if want[token] == got[token]:
103	            continue
104	        value = by_token[token]
105	        if got[token] > want[token] and want[token] > 0:
106	            detail = f"duplicate item: appears {got[token]} times, expected {want[token]}"
107	        elif got[token] > want[token]:
108	            detail = "unexpected item"
109	        else:
110	            detail = "item missing"
111	        out.append((path, f"{value!r} x{want[token]}", f"{value!r} x{got[token]}", detail))
112	    if want == got and [_token(v) for v in expected] != [_token(v) for v in actual]:
113	        out.append((path, expected, actual, "same items in a different order"))
114	
115	
116	def _rule_for(path: str, mapping: Mapping) -> Optional[str]:
117	    plain = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "", path)
118	    best, best_len = None, -1
119	    for rule in mapping.rules:
120	        if plain == rule.target or plain.startswith(rule.target + "."):
121	            rule_id = rule.id
122	            if rule.items and plain.startswith(rule.target + "."):
123	                member = plain[len(rule.target) + 1:].split(".")[0]
124	                if any(name == member for name, _ in rule.items):
125	                    rule_id = f"{rule.id}.{member}"
126	            if len(rule.target) > best_len:
127	                best, best_len = rule_id, len(rule.target)
128	    if best is None:  # a whole object is missing or extra: name the rules writing inside it
129	        inside = [r.id for r in mapping.rules if r.target.startswith(plain + ".")]
130	        if inside:
131	            return ",".join(inside)
132	    return best
133	
134	
135	def _compare(result: VerifyResult, mapping: Mapping, index: int, expected, actual) -> None:
136	    diffs: List[Tuple[str, Any, Any, str]] = []
137	    _diff(expected, actual, "", diffs)
138	    for path, e, a, detail in diffs:
139	        result.mismatches.append(Mismatch(index, path, _rule_for(path, mapping), e, a, detail))
140	
141	
142	def verify(
143	    layout: Layout,
144	    mapping: Mapping,
145	    data: bytes,
146	    actual_docs: List[Dict[str, Any]],
147	    key: Optional[str] = None,
148	    actual_rejects: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
149	) -> VerifyResult:
150	    """Compare a pipeline's loaded documents (and optionally its rejects) with the specification.
151	
152	    Documents are matched by the dotted ``key`` path (default: the target of the
153	    mapping's ``key`` rule), or by position when no key is available.
154	    """
155	    if key is None and mapping.key_rule is not None:
156	        key = mapping.key_rule.target
157	    records = split_records(layout, data)
158	    expected = [json_ready(run_pipeline(r, layout, mapping)) for r in records]
159	    loaded = [(i, e) for i, e in enumerate(expected) if REJECTED not in e and FILTERED not in e]
160	    rejected = [(i, e) for i, e in enumerate(expected) if REJECTED in e]
161	    filtered = [(i, e) for i, e in enumerate(expected) if FILTERED in e]
162	    result = VerifyResult(len(records), len(loaded), len(rejected), len(filtered))
163	
164	    if key:
165	        index: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
166	        for doc in actual_docs:
167	            index.setdefault(_token(get_path(doc, key, _MISSING)), []).append(doc)
168	        for token, docs in index.items():
169	            if len(docs) > 1:
170	                result.problems.append(
171	                    f"duplicate output: {key} = {get_path(docs[0], key, '<missing>')!r} "
172	                    f"appears {len(docs)} times")
173	        expected_tokens = set()
174	        for i, doc in loaded:
175	            token = _token(get_path(doc, key, _MISSING))
176	            expected_tokens.add(token)
177	            if token not in index:
178	                result.problems.append(
179	                    f"record {i}: document {key} = {get_path(doc, key)!r} is missing from the output")
180	            else:
181	                _compare(result, mapping, i, doc, index[token][0])
182	        for i, doc in rejected + filtered:
183	            token = _token(get_path(doc, key, _MISSING))
184	            if token in index and token not in expected_tokens:
185	                why = (f"rejected ({', '.join(doc[REJECTED])})" if REJECTED in doc
186	                       else "filtered out by the mapping filter")
187	                result.problems.append(
188	                    f"record {i}: {key} = {get_path(doc, key)!r} was loaded but should be {why}")
189	                expected_tokens.add(token)
190	        for token, docs in index.items():
191	            if token not in expected_tokens:
192	                result.problems.append(
193	                    f"unexpected document in output: {key} = {get_path(docs[0], key, '<missing>')!r}")
194	    else:
195	        if len(actual_docs) != len(loaded):
196	            result.problems.append(
197	                f"expected {len(loaded)} loaded documents ({len(rejected)} rejected, "
198	                f"{len(filtered)} filtered), got {len(actual_docs)}")
199	        want = Counter(_token(e) for _, e in loaded)
200	        got = Counter(_token(a) for a in actual_docs)
201	        for token, count in got.items():
202	            if count > max(want[token], 1):
203	                result.problems.append(f"duplicate output: the same document appears {count} times")
204	        for (i, e), a in zip(loaded, actual_docs):
205	            _compare(result, mapping, i, e, a)
206	
207	    if actual_rejects is not None:
208	        if key:
209	            want_rejects = Counter(_token(get_path(e, key, _MISSING)) for _, e in rejected)
210	            got_rejects = Counter(_token(get_path(r, key, _MISSING)) for r in actual_rejects)
211	            for token in sorted(set(want_rejects) | set(got_rejects)):
212	                if want_rejects[token] != got_rejects[token]:
213	                    shown = token if token != repr(_MISSING) else "<no key>"
214	                    result.problems.append(
215	                        f"reject file: {key} = {shown} expected {want_rejects[token]} time(s), "
216	                        f"found {got_rejects[token]}")
217	        elif len(actual_rejects) != len(rejected):
218	            result.problems.append(
219	                f"reject file: expected {len(rejected)} rejected records, found {len(actual_rejects)}")
220	
221	    for rule in mapping.rules:  # dataset-level uniqueness
222	        if not any(op == "unique" for op, _ in rule.checks):
223	            continue
224	        values = Counter(
225	            _token(v) for v in (get_path(d, rule.target, None) for d in actual_docs) if v is not None
226	        )
227	        for token, count in values.items():
228	            if count > 1:
229	                result.mismatches.append(Mismatch(
230	                    None, rule.target, rule.id, "unique values", f"{token} in {count} documents",
231	                    "duplicate value across records"))
232	    return result
